caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
relations: The roller's back-and-forth motion presses green paint onto the metal fence surface, creating a wet, uniform layer that adheres temporarily to the metal.
Paint transfers from the roller to the fence, spreading evenly without dripping due to gravity, forming a smooth, continuous film.
The metal fence remains structurally intact while the applied paint layer visibly thickens and becomes opaque, covering the original surface.
